Name: (CP) Vanillaish Samantha (Genderbend Sam)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbend musician/guitarist, Sam, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Currently there is no matching sprites yet, I'll draw her sprites if I have more free time (you know me).

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Sam into your mod folder.
﻿- In configuration, choose between variety of versions:
﻿ ﻿Yes or No for SamHairBun (or type "Yes", "No" under SamHairBun in the config.json file).
﻿ ﻿Pink, Teal, Yellow, Short for SamLowerHair (or type "Pink", "Teal", "Yellow", "Short" under SamLowerHair in cofig.json file). See the image for example.

[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Sam portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Sam changes in those mod.

[b]PERMISSIONS: [/b]As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

[b]SIDENOTE: [/b]You may ask[b] "[/b]Why did you design her like this?/Why she look so different from the vanilla/Adarin's version?". The answer is I that thought those versions had the most unrealistic hairstyles (Saiyan hair and some weird spiky? hair). I also found out that most of the real life musicians (or at least, my artist/musician friend whom I took reference from) always have 'that' messy look. And, I think her design emphasize differences between a boy/girl with their father Kent who looks more 'seasoned'.

[b]CREDITS:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] for inspiration.
